name: Live duration increment
purpose: One bounded live walk for DSP-18: an agent may edit formatDuration in an isolated experiment repository, a local gate runs the project's own tests, and the run stops. This is not the external DSpatch development loop.
notes: A handful of nodes on purpose. The runner still walks the file: changing e-fail or e-spec changes the path. The verify gate has no role and must not spend a provider turn — the live executor runs node --test itself. Do not point this graph at the DSpatch repository.

limits.note: Three calls is room for the writing agent and the local test gate, with one spare. The implementer node is also bounded at 15 minutes so a hung provider call cannot hold the runner.

failureKinds.label: specification error
failureKinds.meaning: The task's premise is wrong and the change cannot be made in place. The run stops rather than inventing a different task.

failureKinds.label: blocked
failureKinds.meaning: A concrete obstacle prevents the change: missing access, or a decision this increment cannot make.

nodes.label: Complete formatDuration
nodes.purpose: Edit src/duration.ts in the isolated experiment repository so the existing tests pass. May write that file without asking. Must not edit tests, add dependencies, or run commands — the next node runs the tests.

nodes.label: Run the project's tests
nodes.purpose: Run node --test test/duration.test.ts in the isolated repository. Pass or fail is the process exit code, not an agent narrative.
nodes.notes: No role and no provider turn. The live executor starts this command itself.

nodes.label: Done
nodes.purpose: The agent edited the file and the project's tests passed.

nodes.label: Failed or abandoned
nodes.purpose: The tests failed, or the agent declared it could not do the work.
